model_note: Distinct-index uniform +1 couplings on 3-regular simple hypergraphs. Not collective p-spin. Not a spin glass.
hamiltonian: H = -sum_a Z_i Z_j Z_k - Gamma * sum_i X_i

qaoa.form: prod_l exp(-i beta_l H_X) exp(-i gamma_l H_C) |+>
qaoa.duration: sum |principal gamma| + sum |principal beta|, period pi folded into (-pi/2, pi/2]

graphs.selection_rule: Ascending PCG64 configuration-model seeds; keep the first k distinct simple 3-regular hypergraphs whose GF(2) incidence matrix has rank N. No energy or fidelity filter.
